mapper.select: SELECT a.*, src.source_name, s.title AS signal_title, c.title AS change_title FROM zentide_observation_activity a LEFT JOIN zentide_source src ON src.source_id=a.source_id LEFT JOIN zentide_signal s ON s.signal_id=a.signal_id LEFT JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=a.change_id WHERE (#{signalId} IS NULL OR a.signal_id=#{signalId}) AND (#{changeId} IS NULL OR a.change_id=#{changeId}) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.activity_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
